run_single_machine_learner_and_actors: run a single machine TorchBeast RL training with multiple actor processes and one learner process
run_actor_process: run an actor process that ignores SIGINT and sets its role and actor_id for Atari RL training
run_learner_process: run a learner process that sets its role to learner and starts the Atari RL training loop
spawn_actor_processes: spawn multiple actor processes using multiprocessing with unique actor IDs for parallel RL training
join_actor_processes: join all spawned actor processes after the learner process completes training
